text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The days following the fulfillment of 
their long-cherished dream were a 
whirlwind, but it was undoubtedly the 
supporters' backing that bridged the gap 
from the challenge to victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as they began taking steps toward 
their next dream—back-to-back victories in 
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe—Mei Satake 
ordered training to be halted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was only after returning home that the 
situation became clear. Members who 
participated in the project began to 
report feeling unwell.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Challenging an environment so different 
from Japan took an excessive toll on the 
Umamusume. Mei Satake felt the heavy 
weight of responsibility.
